name: Pina Colada Dip
description: A creamy and tropical dip made with pineapple, coconut pudding, and sour cream, perfect for serving with fresh fruit.
recipeIngredient: 3½ oz package instant coconut pudding and pie filling (or 1 vanilla pudding and ¼ cup shredded coconut with coconut extract)

recipeInstructions.text: Blend all ingredients together in a food processor or blender until smooth.
Refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to meld.
Serve chilled with a variety of fresh fruits.

keywords: pina colada dip, fruit dip, coconut pudding, party appetizer

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Pineapple Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and tangy chicken dish baked in a pineapple-based sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.
recipeIngredient: ⅗ cup (¼ cup + 2 Tbsp) crushed pineapple, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Simmer the chicken breasts in water until cooked through, turning occasionally.
In a pan, combine crushed pineapple, vinegar, brown sugar, salt, ketchup, and water. Cook over heat, stirring until the sauce thickens.
Place the cooked chicken in a casserole dish and pour the sweet and sour sauce over the top.
Cover the dish with tinfoil and bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken

_similar.name: Spinach Dip
_similar.description: A creamy spinach dip made with sour cream, mayonnaise, and Knorr vegetable soup mix, served in a hollowed-out pumpernickel bread loaf.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (300 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 can (10 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped

recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze excess moisture from the thawed spinach.
In a bowl, combine the spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, Knorr soup mix, water chestnuts, and green onions. Stir until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
If using a bread loaf, scoop out a large hollow through the top and fill with the dip mixture. Serve with bread cubes cut from the centre and/or assorted fresh vegetables.

_similar.keywords: spinach dip, party appetizer, pumpernickel bread
